title: Passes feeding passes
sub: One small function, simplified a pass at a time.

frames.caption: The function as written (in a simplified IR, one operation per line). Nothing about it is obviously wasteful to a human reading quickly.
Constant propagation: a is always 4, so its value replaces its use.
Constant folding and more propagation: 4 × 8 = 32, so c = 32 − 32 = 0, and the branch condition becomes 0 ≠ 0. Each pass feeds the next.

Dead-code elimination: the branch can never be taken, so it goes (and with it a division that would have trapped on c = 0). a, b and c are no longer used by anything, so they go too. d + 32 − 32 simplifies to d.

Strength reduction and copy propagation: multiplying by 2 becomes an add (or a shift), and d disappears. Seven operations became one. None of this changed what the function returns; the compiler only had to prove each step safe.
